status: Exploratory exact-token category analysis; not independent human semantic ground truth.

definitions.parking: Vehicle-type or generic vehicle nouns; manufacturers and model names excluded.
definitions.pilot: Aircraft-type or generic aircraft nouns; manufacturers/model names and vague craft excluded. Balloon included as an aircraft type.
definitions.music: Musical instrument names or the generic instrument category; complete conventional names/abbreviations only. Adjectives, parts and presumed prefix completions excluded.
definitions.location: Recognized single-token geographic names in an explicit finite list. Context-category endpoint, not semantic similarity to baseline the; incomplete multiword place prefixes excluded.
definitions.action: Explicit door-interaction verbs, including opening/closing actions. Context-category endpoint, not semantic similarity to feel/walk and not a grammaticality or plausibility score.
